items.summary: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. items.titleZh: 通过策略自蒸馏从未标记视频中学习视频预见推理
items.summaryZh: 视频预见推理需要视觉语言模型来预测当前观察到的视频中的未来事件或下一步行动。现有的方法适合未来的标题、基本原理或完整的视觉状态，但面临两个限制。首先，它们依赖注释或外部大型模型进行监督，限制了可扩展性。我们通过策略自蒸馏框架来解决这个问题，该框架将过去未来的视频对转换为自然的自我监督信号，无需额外的注释或法学硕士监督。其次，他们认为整个未来的剪辑同样有价值，尽管其中大部分是无关的……

items.summary: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. items.summary: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. items.summary: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. items.summary: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. items.title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
items.summary: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. items.summary: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text.
